artifact.snippet: US: Profiling Question Data Structure: As a developer, I need a data structure (e.g., TypeScript interface and JSON/TS file) to define profiling questions, including conditional `next_question_id` based on answers, so that the quiz can implement dynamic, branching logic.

artifact.reason: Existing question data structure, provides a pattern for defining questions and answers. The new ProfilingQuestion interface will be similar but include branching logic.
Example of how interfaces are defined and exported in the project, which should be followed for ProfilingQuestion.

constraint.description: All data structures and logic must be implemented in TypeScript.
Profiling questions should be stored in a TypeScript file (e.g., `src/lib/profiling/questions.ts`) as an exported array of objects, following the pattern of `src/lib/questions.ts`.
The `ProfilingQuestion` data structure must support dynamic, branching logic using a `conditional_next_question_id` or similar mechanism.
New files for profiling questions (types and data) should be placed in `src/lib/profiling/`.

interface.name: ProfilingQuestion
interface.reason: New interface required to define the structure of profiling questions, including branching logic.

tests.standards: Unit tests should be written using Vitest. Test files should be co-located with the modules they test, following the pattern `*.test.ts` or `*.spec.ts`. Focus on algorithmic correctness, data transformations, and edge cases.

ideas.idea: Write a unit test to validate the schema of the `ProfilingQuestion` interface, ensuring all required properties are present and correctly typed.
Write a unit test to verify that `profilingQuestions.ts` exports an array of `ProfilingQuestion` objects, and that each object conforms to the defined interface.
Write a unit test to verify the branching logic of the sample question tree, ensuring that `conditional_next_question_id` correctly directs to the next question based on selected answers.
